ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 80-85% high-intensity white pixels concentrated in the central lobes, with 15-20% low-intensity black pixels localized at the trailing edge, distal tips, and basal insertion.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white pigmentation across the medial and lateral regions of both lobes. A prominent vertical black pigmentation band extends from the peduncle insertion, tapering into the median notch. Solid black banding (5-20 pixel width) follows the entire trailing edge contour.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 50 degrees; notch apex is sharp with high-contrast definition against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing boundary. Notable high-amplitude peaks (4-8 pixels) present on the right lobe trailing edge; the left lobe displays a more micro-serrated, lower-amplitude topography.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to a broad convex sweep before terminating in acute, upward-tapering distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible indentation/irregular notch on the upper trailing edge of the right lobe, appearing as a non-symmetrical loss of tissue compared to the left lobe; extensive rake marks concentrated on the right lobe's white surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Isolated small black pixel cluster (pigmentation spot) located in the lower quadrant of the left white lobe, approximately 30% distance from the basal midline.
